"""Independent cell-array replay; no coefficient census or new words."""
import json,hashlib,os,sys,platform,subprocess,time,datetime,tempfile,resource
from pathlib import Path
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(120,120));resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1024**3,1024**3))
start=time.monotonic();root=Path(os.environ.get('RULE30_REPLAY_ROOT',os.getcwd()));sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
p=root/'results/problem1/20260906_sixteen_potential_primary.json';wrap=json.loads(p.read_text());records={}
assert sha(wrap['source_text'].encode())==wrap['result_hashes']['source_sha256']
assert sha(json.dumps(wrap['result_summary'],sort_keys=True).encode())==wrap['result_hashes']['summary_sha256']
for name,run in wrap['runs'].items():
 assert sha(run['raw_json_text'].encode())==run['raw_sha256']
 r=json.loads(run['raw_json_text']);records[name]=r
 assert sha(run['source_text'].encode())==run['source_sha256']==r['result_hashes']['self_sha256']
 for name2,h in r['result_hashes']['notes'].items():assert sha((root/name2).read_bytes())==h
 assert sha((root/'src/python/rule30_research_reference.py').read_bytes())==r['result_hashes']['reference_sha256']
main=records['constraints'];sep=records['separator']
assert sha(wrap['runs']['constraints']['raw_json_text'].encode())==sep['frozen_json_hash']
assert sha(json.dumps(main['refinement_all_u'],sort_keys=True).encode())==main['result_hashes']['refinement_sha256']
# Cell operations, with P built from its odd-section identity.
def T(x):
 b=[(x>>i)&1 for i in range(x.bit_length()+2)]
 c=[]
 for i in range(len(b)):c.append(b[i]^int((i>=1 and b[i-1]) or (i>=2 and b[i-2])))
 return sum(v<<i for i,v in enumerate(c))
def G(x,g):return T(x) if g=='t' else T(x)^1 if g=='u' else T(2*x+1)>>1
def evaluate(a,w):
 x={'p':3,'u':1}[a]
 for g in w:x=G(x,g)
 return x
def H(a,w):
 z={'p':3,'u':1}[a];letters=[]
 for g in w:z=G(z,g);letters.append('tupp'[z%4])
 return ''.join(letters)
def counts(a,w):
 z={'p':3,'u':1}[a];n=[0]*48
 for g in w:n[3*(z%16)+'tup'.index(g)]+=1;z=G(z,g)
 return n,z%16
all_diffs=[];dots=[];rows=[];states_checked=updates_checked=0
for b in main['result_summary']['blocks']:
 a=b['phase'];w=b['from_zero'][1:];x=evaluate(a,w)
 assert len(w)==b['k']-1 and hex(x)==b['x_hex']
 histories=[w];states=[x];qs=[]
 for i in range(b['cut']+6):
  q={7:'u',11:'t'}.get(x%16);assert q is not None
  nw=H(a,w)+q;xx=G(G(x>>2,'p'),q)
  assert evaluate(a,nw)==xx
  w=nw;x=xx;histories.append(w);states.append(x);qs.append(q);updates_checked+=1
 assert [hex(x) for x in states]==b['states_hex'];states_checked+=len(states)
 assert ''.join(qs)==b['branches_all'] and ''.join(qs[b['cut']:])=='ututut'
 assert not any(f in ''.join(qs)+'u' for f in ('uu','ttttt','ututtu'))
 wi,wf=histories[b['cut']],histories[-1]
 assert (wi,wf)==(b['word_initial'],b['word_final'])
 ci,ti=counts(a,wi);cf,tf=counts(a,wf);d=[y-x for x,y in zip(ci,cf)]
 assert ci==b['counts_initial'] and cf==b['counts_final'] and d==b['diff']
 assert (ti,tf)==(b['term_initial_mod16'],b['term_final_mod16'])
 dot=d[0]+d[3]+d[4]+2*d[18]
 dots.append(dot);all_diffs.append(d)
 rows.append({'id':b['id'],'word_initial':wi,'word_final':wf,'initial':ci,'final':cf,'diff':d,'Wdagger_change':dot,'terminal_residues':[ti,tf]})
assert dots==sep['dots']==[-2,-2,-2,-1,-1,-1]
assert sha(json.dumps(all_diffs,sort_keys=True).encode())==main['result_hashes']['diffs_sha256']==sep['diffs_hash']
assert sha(json.dumps(dots,sort_keys=True).encode())==sep['dots_hash']
# Check divergence from edge endpoints independently; only three rows are circulations.
divs=[]
for d in all_diffs:
 div=[0]*16
 for v in range(16):
  for gi,g in enumerate('tup'):
   val=d[3*v+gi];div[v]+=val;div[G(v,g)%16]-=val
 divs.append(div)
summary={'all_count_tables_agree':True,'blocks':6,'states_checked':states_checked,'prescribed_updates':updates_checked,'edge_weights':{'0,t':1,'1,t':1,'1,u':1,'6,t':2},'block_changes':dots,'divergences':divs,'all_coefficient_separation_verified':True,'new_words':0,'coefficient_search_repeated':False}

out=Path(os.environ.get('RULE30_REPLAY_OUTPUT',root/'results/problem1/20260906_sixteen_potential_independent.json'));fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(dir=out.parent,prefix=out.name+'.')
